dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit dark, sharp perimeter gradients transitioning into lighter tan interior pigments. Prominent examples include a closed circle in the lower-mid quadrant and a series of interlocking arcs along the central dorsal line.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid pixel clusters. Occasional small, high-intensity tan spots are visible near the posterior fluke junction, appearing as isolated, non-gradient points against the dark substrate.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent circular rings in the central-lateral region form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary cluster of four smaller annuli in the posterior-midsection forms an irregular trapezoidal polygon.
